title: PLAY DATA PAGE AND SETTINGS PANE POLISH
why: Job 113, critic round 2 (both pages scored 3): the play data counts become the page headline, the actions group tightly, restore sits in its own quiet panel with a one line amber warning, and the settings detail pane packs to its content with a tx-1 hero value and an on-grid chip.
now: Send play data reads as a headline, one copy button and a quiet restore panel; the settings detail pane no longer shows a tall empty box.

edits.anchor: Paste a RESTORE CODE from the end of a run report. It REPLACES the save you are playing. Read it first: the game will tell you whose character it is before anything is written.
edits.replacement: paste a restore code. replaces your save.
